question: Which of the following is a temperate marine climate with substantial rainfall in all seasons?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cfb.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Köppen climate region **Cfb is described as the Marine west coast climate **because the climate is set up along the western beachfront of mainlands worldwide.
 
• Its high moisture utmostly characterizes it.
 
• **Cfb = Temperate oceanic climate or tropical upland climate; coldest month averaging above 0 °C( 32 °F)( or −3 °C( 27 °F)), all months with average temperatures below 22 °C(71.6 °F), and at least four months comprising above 10 °C( 50 °F).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Am:** Tropical monsoon climate
 
• **BSh:** Hot semi-arid climate.
 
• **BSk: **Cold semi-arid climate.
